site.summary: greengrove-clone Fictional pet insurance "GreenGrove" marketing site, including a 6-step quote wizard. Pages | File | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `index.html` | Landing page: hand-drawn dog illustration hero + 3 value props + customer review cards + FAQ entry | | `quote.html` | 6-step quote wizard: 1 pet type (6 icon cards) / 2 breed (200+ dogs, 60+ cats, other species auto-switched ARIA combobox with searchable dropdown — keyboard up/down/Enter/Esc) / 3 age (year/month toggle + stepper) / 4 pre-existing conditions (19 chip multi-select + None toggle) / 5 three tier cards (Sprout / Sapling / Oak) + deductible dropdown + collapsible side-by-side comparison table + live per-tier quote / 6 quote summary (monthly fee + annual total + inclusions + 14-day price lock mock); top 6-step dot indicator allows jumping back; floating Back / Continue bar | | `faq.html` | 12 common-question `<details>` accordion |

run_plan.goal: Exhaustively explore the 6-step quote wizard, validate the claims submission form, and check FAQ interactions across desktop and mobile.
run_plan.summary: The exploration will start on the landing page to verify navigation, then dedicate the majority of effort to deeply exercising the 6-step quote wizard (especially the custom breed combobox and multi-select conditions). Afterward, it will validate the claims form and FAQ accordions. A final mobile pass will ensure the complex wizard UI and small tap targets remain usable on smaller screens.
assumptions: The 6-step quote wizard is contained within a single HTML file (quote.html) using JavaScript to manage state and DOM updates.
The breed combobox supports keyboard navigation (up/down/enter/esc) as described in the summary.
Form submissions (Claims) might be mocked but should have validation or success states.
